args.subject: 8 Vellum Court, Brindlewick, ZZ1 1ZZ: approval needed for electrical visit (TV and bedroom light)
args.body:
Dear Mr Wex,

Re: 8 Vellum Court, Brindlewick, ZZ1 1ZZ. Thank you for your reply of 5 September asking us to sort the TV fault. We need two quick decisions before we confirm an electrician.

1. Downstairs bedroom light: the tenant reports it flickers and makes a popping noise when switched on. Your approval covered the TV only. May we include an inspection of this light, with the electrician resolving it where possible or quoting if significant, in the same visit? The tenant is using a lamp for now.

2. The TV: you said you do not remember leaving a TV. Do you know whether it belongs to the property? The tenant thinks the TV's main board has failed and is open to its removal. If it is the tenant's, the electrician's time on the TV would not be a landlord cost. Please tell us whether you want us to (a) have the electrician assess the TV, or (b) leave the TV out of the visit and cover only the light. Please also say whether you want any spending limit applied.

Bracken Spark Services has offered 29 September after 15:00, which is within the tenant's availability. We will confirm it once we hear from you.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings

args.subject: Electrical visit update - 8 Vellum Court, Brindlewick, ZZ1 1ZZ
args.body:
Dear Ms Pell,

Thank you for your availability. The electrician has offered 29 September after 15:00, which matches one of your slots. We are waiting on the landlord to confirm the scope, including the downstairs light and the TV, before we confirm the visit. We will then confirm a time and ask the electrician to call on arrival because of the dog. Please keep the TV unplugged. Please also submit the rear-door handle as a separate request, as agreed on the call.

Kind regards,
Northbridge Lettings

args.reason: Waiting for Landlord: approval for the downstairs light, TV ownership and scope, needed before confirming Bracken Spark's 29 Sept visit. The landlord's auto-reply said they were away.

args.summary: Asked the landlord to approve the light inspection and to confirm TV ownership and scope. The visit is not confirmed yet. The tenant has been updated and a follow-up is set for 22 Sept.
facts: Landlord approval (event 3) was in reply to a TV-only request (event 2); no spending limit was recorded (event 4).
The downstairs light was never put to the landlord (events 2, 5).
The landlord said they do not remember leaving a TV (event 3). The tenant thinks the board is fried and is open to removing the TV (event 15).
The landlord's auto-reply says they are away (event 7).
The tenant offered slots (event 16). Bracken Spark proposed 29 Sept after 15:00, with no exact time and no confirmation sent (event 19).
The rear-door handle is a separate matter and has not been reported (events 15, 18).
conflicts: The landlord's approval covers only the TV, but the visit request combines the TV and the light (events 3, 17).
TV ownership and liability are unresolved (event 3).
missing: Landlord approval for the light work
Whether the TV is the landlord's, and whether to assess it
An exact arrival time from the electrician
options_rejected: Confirming the 29 Sept visit now: the light work has no landlord approval and the TV scope is uncertain.
Escalating: one landlord message can settle both questions.
Charging the tenant: there is no evidence of tenant damage or of who owns the TV.
args.uncertainty: The landlord is away, so a reply may be slow. If there is no reply by the follow-up date, chase again and consider escalating if the silence continues.
